import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_NODES = 10;
    static final int MODULUS = 1000000007;

    static class HashFunction {
        public long hash(long x) {
            // Simple hash function for demonstration
            return x ^ 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15L;
        }
    }

    static class ModNumber {
        int value;

        public ModNumber(long v) {
            v %= MODULUS;
            if (v < 0) v += MODULUS;
            this.value = (int) v;
        }

        public static int extendedGCD(int a, int m, int[] xy) {
            if (m == 0) {
                xy[0] = 1; xy[1] = 0;
                return a;
            }
            int[] yx = new int[2];
            int g = extendedGCD(m, a % m, yx);
            xy[0] = yx[1];
            xy[1] = yx[0] - (a / m) * yx[1];
            return g;
        }

        public static int modularInverse(int a) {
            int[] xy = new int[2];
            extendedGCD(a, MODULUS, xy);
            int x = xy[0];
            return (x % MODULUS + MODULUS) % MODULUS;
        }

        public ModNumber add(ModNumber other) {
            int res = this.value + other.value;
            if (res >= MODULUS) res -= MODULUS;
            return new ModNumber(res);
        }

        public ModNumber subtract(ModNumber other) {
            int res = this.value - other.value;
            if (res < 0) res += MODULUS;
            return new ModNumber(res);
        }

        public ModNumber multiply(ModNumber other) {
            long res = ((long) this.value) * other.value;
            res %= MODULUS;
            return new ModNumber(res);
        }

        public ModNumber divide(ModNumber other) {
            return this.multiply(new ModNumber(modInverse(other.value)));
        }

        public static int modInverse(int a) {
            return modularInverse(a);
        }

        public ModNumber pow(long p) {
            assert p >= 0;
            ModNumber base = this;
            ModNumber result = new ModNumber(1);
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) result = result.multiply(base);
                base = base.multiply(base);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        public static ModNumber inverse(int a) {
            return new ModNumber(modInverse(a));
        }

        public int intValue() {
            return value;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        int total_N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        ModNumber[][] probability_matrix = new ModNumber[total_N][total_N];

        for (int i = 0; i < total_N; i++) {
            String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
            for (int j = 0; j < total_N; j++) {
                int p = Integer.parseInt(parts[j]);
                probability_matrix[i][j] = new ModNumber(p).divide(new ModNumber(100));
            }
        }

        List<List<Integer>> masks_by_count = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int c = 0; c <= total_N; c++) {
            masks_by_count.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        int[] index_lookup = new int[1 << total_N];
        Arrays.fill(index_lookup, -1);
        for (int m = 0; m < (1 << total_N); m++) {
            int c = Integer.bitCount(m);
            index_lookup[m] = masks_by_count.get(c).size();
            masks_by_count.get(c).add(m);
        }

        Map<Long, ModNumber> possible_states = new HashMap<>();
        long initial_mask = 1L << index_lookup[0];
        possible_states.put(initial_mask, new ModNumber(1));

        for (int left_part = 0; left_part < total_N; left_part++) {
            Map<Long, ModNumber> new_states = new HashMap<>();
            ModNumber[] product_mask = new ModNumber[1 << total_N];
            for (int mask_curr = 0; mask_curr < (1 << total_N); mask_curr++) {
                ModNumber prod = new ModNumber(1);
                for (int r = 0; r < total_N; r++) {
                    if (((mask_curr >> r) & 1) == 1) {
                        prod = prod.multiply(probability_matrix[left_part][r]);
                    } else {
                        prod = prod.multiply(new ModNumber(1).subtract(probability_matrix[left_part][r]));
                    }
                }
                product_mask[mask_curr] = prod;
            }

            long[] new_bits = new long[total_N];
            ModNumber[] new_possible_mask = new ModNumber[1 << total_N];
            Arrays.fill(new_possible_mask, new ModNumber(0));

            for (Map.Entry<Long, ModNumber> state : possible_states.entrySet()) {
                long current_mask = state.getKey();
                ModNumber prob_value = state.getValue();

                Arrays.fill(new_bits, 0);
                for (int m : masks_by_count.get(left_part)) {
                    if (((current_mask >> index_lookup[m]) & 1) == 1) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < total_N; i++) {
                            if (((m >> i) & 1) == 0) {
                                int new_mask_index = index_lookup[m | (1 << i)];
                                new_bits[i] |= 1L << new_mask_index;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                Arrays.fill(new_possible_mask, new ModNumber(0));
                for (int curr_mask = 1; curr_mask < (1 << total_N); curr_mask++) {
                    int ctz = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(curr_mask);
                    long combined_mask = new ModNumber(0);
                    combined_mask = new ModNumber(0);
                    combined_mask = new ModNumber(0);
                    // To simulate bitwise OR over multiple bits, we can do:
                    // But in Java, we need to do it carefully
                    // Instead, we can do:
                    // new_possible_mask[curr_mask] = new_possible_mask[curr_mask & (curr_mask - 1)] | new_bits[ctz]
                    // So, implement accordingly:
                    if (curr_mask == 1) {
                        new_possible_mask[curr_mask] = new ModNumber(new_bits[ctz]);
                    } else {
                        new_possible_mask[curr_mask] = new ModNumber(new_possible_mask[curr_mask & (curr_mask - 1)].intValue() | (int) new_bits[ctz]);
                    }
                    long mask_value = new_possible_mask[curr_mask].intValue();
                    ModNumber new_prob = prob_value.multiply(product_mask[curr_mask]);
                    new_states.put(mask_value, new_states.getOrDefault(mask_value, new ModNumber(0)).add(new_prob));
                }
            }
            possible_states = new_states;
        }

        ModNumber total_answer = new ModNumber(0);
        int last_mask_index = index_lookup[(1 << total_N) - 1];
        for (Map.Entry<Long, ModNumber> state : possible_states.entrySet()) {
            if (((state.getKey() >> last_mask_index) & 1) == 1) {
                total_answer = total_answer.add(state.getValue());
            }
        }
        System.out.println(total_answer.intValue());
    }
}
